answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove duplicate or fraudulent behavior. New identities earn trust only through attested useful work, so a reputation cannot be conjured by an echo chamber of sock puppets. Cap onboarding at one verified identity per stake per epoch, a narrow ledge that makes a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes. Carve that history into a public ledger as solid as marble, so fakes cannot rewrite their past, and the cost of forging a thousand credible histories dwarfs any sybil gain.
